title: commit-msg warns that check-trailers refuses a sprint's close commit, which it accepts
goal: The commit-msg hook warns, on a sprint's close commit (KB-Work: SP-..., the sprint's file deleted by that commit), that KB-Work names an item that does not exist and that check-trailers refuses it; check-trailers accepts the close (bad=0 on SP-gfz3rl64's close, 469649ff3). The hook reads a sprint id the commit deletes, or one git's history has, as check-trailers does, and warns only of what check-trailers refuses. Seen on SP-gfz3rl64's close amend.

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile,os;f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'m');open(f,'w').write('chore(backlog): close SP-gfz3rl64 "x"

KB-Work: SP-gfz3rl64
');p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbgit.py','hook','commit-msg',f],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(1 if 'refuses this commit' in p.stdout+p.stderr else 0)
